sections.Profile:
Hang Glider , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in December 1976, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Jim Patla, with artwork by Dick White.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Aviation, Hang Gliding, Hobbies, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Jim Patla
- Art: Dick White
sections.Editions: - Hang Glider: 2,325 made, released 1976-12-01, model number 1079
